Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
On Tue, 03 Oct 2000 14:51:44 GMT, francoi...@my-deja.com wrote:

>1) Can I add any bleed bonus that any vampire may have after having
>played a sup. "Pulse of the Canaille"? That is, Ozmo with sup. Pulse
>may bleed for 3 or 4 pool?

Anvil bum's rushes Ozmo, so it doesn't matter - he can't do EITHER
from torpor anyway.

If Ozmo gets rescued from torpor before he gets munched, and then
doesn't get blocked in the hunt after that, he will have a current
bleed of 4. (base 1, +2 for Pulse, +1 for special.)

>2) Are the "Carthage Remembered" stealth bonus cumulative if I played 2
>or more (it's not unique master and there isn't any indication about
>playing more than 1).

Probably. I'm too lazy to look up the card text today. =) But it
would seem appropriate. =)
-- Derek

Carthage Remembered
Type: Master
Clan: Brujah

Pool Cost: 1

Card Text:

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
KingJohann wrote:
> >Carthage Remembered

> So with the text stating Brujah Princes or Justicars, does that mean I can have
> two Brujahs that are justicars getting this bonus, i.e. Ulugh Beg with a Clan
> Impersonation?

No, because Ulugh loses the benefit of his title (which is "Justicar of X",
not just "Justicar") for as long as he is not Tremere. See section 10 of the
rulebook for more information.
